programme.title: Gentle Ben 2: Black Gold
programme.desc: In this sequel, the use of land abutting the wilderness sparks conflict for Fog (who owns the land) and Jack. Rather than drill for oil, Fog says he'll open a natural spring-water business, but Jack doesn't believe him, and ends up being jailed for sabotaging the operation.

programme.title: Sweet Surrender
programme.desc: After spending years in the military, a young man returns to his hometown to take over operation of his ailing grandmother's bed-and-breakfast, where he must contend with an old flame who's scheming to get the property turned into a mall.

programme.title: Return to Sender
programme.desc: When a weathered old envelope appears in the mailbox of Meg's new apartment marked Return to Sender, she joins the building manager Ollie along with podcaster Ellen and partner Pete to find out who sent this mysterious love letter.

programme.title: Fielder's Choice
programme.desc: A perfectionist adman (Chad Lowe) becomes a surrogate dad when the death of his sister lands his rambunctious nephew (K'Sun Ray) in his care. George Segal. Holly: Marin Hinkle.

programme.title: Oliver's Ghost
programme.desc: A young boy (Nicholas Stargel) befriends a ghost (Martin Mull) living in the attic of his family's new house in a small town. After several angry outbursts from the ghost, the boy tries to get to the bottom of what's plaguing him. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: Though None Go with Me
programme.desc: Elizabeth Leroy devotes her life to serving God but her faith is tested over the years as she has to overcome many hardships and sorrows.

programme.title: Legally Tender
programme.desc: A new homeowner learns that her property is where the first Thanksgiving took place, and then she must fight to keep her house because a historian wants to raze it in order to study the historic site.

programme.title: Love Takes Wing
programme.desc: A young doctor (Sarah Jones) moves to a town where a strange illness has stricken several residents, particularly those in the local orphanage. Despite their peril, the townspeople resist her efforts to help because she's a woman, so the doctor must find a way to save the town before it's too late. Haylie Duff, Cloris Leachman, Patrick Duffy. Directed by Lou Diamond Phillips, who also stars. Based on the novel by Janette Oke.

programme.title: Diagnosis Delicious

programme.desc: Rachel, a NYC appraiser is sent to a small town to buy out a library so her client can build a resort. She meets Jake, a local writer who tries to convince her how important the library is to the small community but the arrival of his niece and nephew complicate his efforts.

programme.desc: A young mob member goes into the Witness Protection Program and settles into a quiet suburban village, where he falls for a local woman and gets involved with cookie-making fund-raising for her daughter's scout troop while dodging his former associates who have tracked him down.

programme.title: The Wishing Well
programme.desc: A jaded journalist (Jordan Ladd) travels to a small town to write a piece about its reportedly magic wishing well. While at the well, she and a young girl (Jadin Gould) make the same wish and set off an unusual series of events that shows the woman how her life could be different. Jason London, Ernest Borgnine, Sally Kellerman, Yeardley Smith and Charles Shaughnessy also star. Directed by David Jackson.

programme.title: Return to Sender
programme.desc: When a weathered old envelope appears in the mailbox of Meg's new apartment marked Return to Sender, she joins the building manager Ollie along with podcaster Ellen and partner Pete to find out who sent this mysterious love letter.

programme.title: Bound & Babysitting
programme.desc: A couple need a babysitter so they can go on a much-needed romantic getaway, so they enlist the help of two friends who have been enemies since college in hopes that they realize how much they have in common.

programme.desc: A young boy (Nicholas Stargel) befriends a ghost (Martin Mull) living in the attic of his family's new house in a small town. After several angry outbursts from the ghost, the boy tries to get to the bottom of what's plaguing him. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.sub-title: St. Louis Blues at Winnipeg Jets
programme.desc: The Jets host the Blues for Game 1 of a Western Conference first-round series. Winnipeg has home ice throughout the playoffs after clinching its first Presidents' Trophy. Winnipeg won three of four meetings with St. Louis during the regular season.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.sub-title: St. Louis Blues at Winnipeg Jets
programme.desc: The Blues and Jets play Game 2 of this Western Conference first-round series. Winnipeg won its third consecutive Game 1 of a playoff set by coming back to beat St. Louis 5-3 on April 19. Kyle Connor (WPG) had three points and the game-winning goal.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.sub-title: Winnipeg Jets at St. Louis Blues
programme.desc: The Blues host the Jets for Game 3 of their Western Conference quarterfinal. Winnipeg leads the series 2-0 after defending home ice, with Kyle Connor scoring the winning goal in each contest. Mark Scheifele (WPG) has five points in the two outings.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.sub-title: Winnipeg Jets at St. Louis Blues
programme.desc: The Blues try to even a West quarterfinal with the Jets in Game 4. Pavel Buchnevich scored twice in the first 3:11 of Game 3 and finished the hat trick in the third as St. Louis coasted to a 7-2 win over Winnipeg. Cam Fowler (STL) had five points.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.sub-title: St. Louis Blues at Winnipeg Jets
programme.desc: The Jets host the Blues for Game 5 of their West quarterfinal. Winnipeg went to St. Louis with a 2-0 series lead, but the Blues scored 12 and chased Connor Hellebuyck twice. Jake Neighbours had three points as the Blues took a 5-1 decision in Game 4.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.sub-title: Winnipeg Jets at St. Louis Blues
programme.desc: The Blues attempt to force a decisive contest as they host the Jets in Game 6 of their West quarterfinal. Kyle Connor scored his fourth of the postseason 83 seconds into Game 5, which Winnipeg went on to win 5-3 to take a 3-2 series advantage.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.sub-title: St. Louis Blues at Winnipeg Jets
programme.desc: The Jets and Blues play for the second round's last spot in Game 7 of their Western Conference quarterfinal. In Game 6, St. Louis chased Vezina frontrunner Connor Hellebuyck (WPG) for a third time this postseason, evening the series with a 5-2 win.

programme.desc: The Eastern Conference-best Capitals host the Canadiens for Game 1 of a first-round set. Montreal was the final team to punch its ticket to the postseason. Washington has lost its last five playoff series since winning the 2018 Stanley Cup Final.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: Alex Ovechkin and the Capitals collide with the Canadiens in Game 2 of their Eastern Conference first-round series. Ovechkin scored twice, including his first career playoff overtime goal, to give Washington a 3-2 victory over Montreal in Game 1.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: Game 3 of this Stanley Cup Playoffs first-round series sees the Canadiens, down 2-0, hosting the Capitals. Washington defended home ice with a 3-1 victory in Game 2. Connor McMichael scored twice for the Caps, while Dylan Strome netted the winner.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: The Canadiens and Capitals play Game 4 of their first-round series. Montreal cut Washington's series lead in half with a 6-3 decision Game 3. Both starting goaltenders, Logan Thompson (WSH) and Sam Montembeault (MTL), left the contest with injury.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: The Capitals try to advance to the second round in Game 5 of their East quarterfinal with the Canadiens. Washington pushed Montreal to the brink by pulling away for a 5-2 Game 4 triumph. Dylan Strome leads the Caps with seven points this postseason.
